Privacy Policy

Effective date: September 18, 2026

This Privacy Policy describes information associated with your use of railball.club, the Railball website operated by Marcus Fontaine in Brooklyn, New York. It covers this website and inquiries made through its contact links; other websites and services have their own policies.

Information associated with your visit

Information you provide. If you contact Marcus by email, phone, or WhatsApp, your communication may include your name, email address, phone number, message, and any details you choose to share. Please do not send payment card details, government identification numbers, medical records, or other sensitive information through these contact channels.

Technical information. Website hosting and security services may process technical information such as your IP address, browser and device information, requested pages, access times, and referring pages in connection with delivering and protecting the website. Technical logging and retention depend on the hosting provider’s services and settings.

The current website does not provide visitor accounts, an on-site contact form, online registration, or payment processing. Its page code does not include a separate analytics or advertising tracking script. This does not mean that hosting services or embedded third-party content collect no information.

How information is used and shared

Information from inquiries is used to respond, discuss Railball and potential participation, and manage related communications. Technical information supports website delivery, troubleshooting, security, and abuse prevention. Information may be processed by hosting and communication providers as needed to provide their services, or disclosed when required by law or reasonably necessary to protect rights, safety, or security.

This site has no mechanism for selling contact details. However, embedded content and external platforms process information under their own policies, and this policy does not promise that those platforms will refrain from advertising or other data uses.

YouTube videos, cookies, and similar technologies

This website uses YouTube API Services through embedded YouTube players. Loading a player can send YouTube technical information, including an IP address, browser or device information, and the page containing the player, even before you play a video. Playing a video can result in additional collection, cookies or similar technologies, and processing by Google or YouTube for playback, preferences, security, measurement, or advertising.

One player uses YouTube’s privacy-enhanced domain. Privacy-enhanced mode limits certain personalization uses; it does not mean that no information is transmitted or that all cookies and similar technologies are eliminated. Learn more in YouTube’s embedding guidance and the Google Privacy Policy.

You can manage cookies through your browser and Google account settings. Browser restrictions may affect video playback. The website does not currently offer a cookie preference manager or a mechanism that blocks all YouTube requests before you make a choice. It does not currently change its embedded players in response to Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control signals. Any obligations to honor legally applicable privacy rights still apply.

External links and contact services

Links to Instagram, YouTube, WhatsApp, and other websites take you to services operated by other parties. Clicking an email link opens your email application; clicking the WhatsApp link opens WhatsApp. Those services may process communications and technical information under their own terms and privacy policies. Review the Instagram Privacy Policy and WhatsApp Privacy Policy when using those services.

Retention and security

Inquiries and related records may be retained for responding, managing ongoing communications, resolving issues, and meeting applicable legal obligations. Retention can vary with the purpose and the service involved, including provider logs and backups. No single retention period applies to all information.

No internet transmission or storage method is completely secure. Avoid including sensitive information in ordinary email or messages.

Your choices and requests

You may contact Marcus to ask what information from your inquiries is held, request correction or deletion, or ask to stop further nonessential communications. Requests will be considered under applicable law; identity verification or retention for legal reasons may be necessary. Information held independently by Google, Meta, or another provider must also be addressed through that provider’s privacy controls or request process. This notice does not limit rights you have under applicable law.

Children and teenagers

This website presents general information about Railball and has no online enrollment process for children. A parent or guardian should make participation inquiries on behalf of a minor. Please do not submit personal information about a child under 13 through these contact links. If you believe a child’s information has been provided, contact Marcus so it can be reviewed and, where appropriate, deleted. Information about minors is subject to applicable children’s privacy laws, including New York requirements.

Changes to this policy

Updates will be posted on this page with a revised effective date. Material changes will be accompanied by any additional notice or consent required by applicable law.
